fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client ID of your Bling app (Central de Extensões > Área do Integrador); sent with the client secret as HTTP Basic on the token request ('não é permitida a inserção destes parâmetros no body').

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Client Secret of the same Bling app.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: refresh_token from a one-time authorization-code exchange (the code expires in 1 minute); valid 30 days. Access tokens last 6 hours (expires_in 21600) and are re-minted from it; a new refresh_token returned by Bling replaces the old one in memory, and with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set it is also saved and preferred on the next start.

me.note: GET /empresas/me/dados-basicos: {data: {id, nome, cnpj, email, dataContrato}} of the connected Bling company.

list_products.note: GET /produtos: the products registered in YOUR Bling ERP (Bling is an ERP/integration hub, not a supplier) [{id, nome, codigo (SKU), preco, precoCusto, estoque.saldoVirtualTotal, tipo, situacao (A active / I inactive), imagemURL}]; `query` filters by nome, `category` is idCategoria. Prices are BRL. stock_balance is estoque.saldoVirtualTotal (a decimal).

get_product.note: GET /produtos/{idProduto}: full product with stock (estoque), default supplier (fornecedor {id, codigo, precoCusto, precoCompra}), dimensions and tax data.

get_order.note: GET /pedidos/compras/{idPedidoCompra}: a purchase order recorded in Bling (pedido de compra to a supplier) {id, numero, data, dataPrevista, total, fornecedor{id}, situacao{id, valor}, transporte, itens[], parcelas[]}. status_code is situacao.valor (0 em aberto, 1 atendido, 2 cancelado, 3 em andamento); `status` is left null because Bling returns a numeric code.

not_offered.quote_shipping: Bling is an ERP; it has no carrier-rate endpoint for a product and destination (logistics endpoints manage shipping objects/labels of existing sales).
not_offered.create_order: POST /pedidos/compras only records a purchase order inside Bling (fornecedor id, itens[{produto{id}, quantidade, valor}]); it is not transmitted to or paid at any supplier, and the vocabulary's shipping_address has no counterpart.
not_offered.track: No tracking-events endpoint for purchase orders; logistics objects (GET /logisticas/objetos/{idObjeto}) belong to sales shipments and take an object id, not an order id.
